method: join assertion-inventory.json (24619 items) against verdict sources. Object->assertion reconstruction per build_worklists.py PANEL_DIM map: the 9 legal-assertion kinds (case_cite/proposition/home_role/quote_pinpoint/link_pincite/treatment/treatment_override/weight_label/registry_callout_pair) are the 3-lane-panel scope; other kinds are editorial/structural -> D3 (1 reviewer + lints), not the panel. Panel-scoped coverage = worklist panel-assigned assertion_ids UNION reviewed_assertion_ids (attestations+opus+codex manifests) UNION finding assertion_ids. Non-panel coverage = home-file membership in the verdicted-file universe (panel objects + finding objects + P4 bridge files + all p4/out sweep artifact files + absence ledger + lint ledger).

exceptions.note: 154 structural items (42 glossary definitions on Common Legal Terms.md + 112 section-index nav link_target/link_mention) route to the R8 corpus-wide LINT roster by design (build_worklists.py: 'kinds NOT in this map are editorial/structural -> 1 reviewer + lints (D3)'), NOT the 3-lane panel. They join to no panel-vote/adjudication/P4-bridge row because they never go to the panel; their verdict is the green lint status, verified by the sibling R14(6) lint spot-verification packet. Not silent drops: every residual maps to an existing content page. Enumerated below.
